items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well he said he had some light colored fellows like Bach Kay and his band. And they passed for white. Yeah a few of those. Sure.

ctx.x: You mentioned the reason the men sound fresh today is, no I mean the reason they sounded fresh in the old days, because they weren't working regularly. They enjoyed playing this once a week or once every two weeks. In the old days they didn't work always steadily? No, no indeed they all had jobs and they got as much kick or more to get paid for doing something that they were crazy about doing. Now you take just these fellas now, these old timers that they've dug up and they're playing at Preservation Hall, they…
Well he said he had some light colored fellows like Bach Kay and his band. And they passed for white. Yeah a few of those. Sure.

That's what Tom Brown was so ugly about. He said that old nigger he referred to Jack as a nigger. Because I'm sure he knew and Tom played with those boys too. There were two of them. Was it Rag Baby Steven?
